title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature adds support for parsing JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing developers to handle complex data in their routes. It improves the framework's usability and stability by providing a built-in way to handle common data formats. This feature is essential for building robust and scalable applications
acceptance: The feature is accepted when request bodies are correctly parsed and handled in routes, with proper error handling for invalid or malformed data
reason: This feature is technically justified as it fills a significant gap in the framework's functionality, making it more competitive with other Node.js frameworks and improving developer experience
